name: playcheck
description: A Crew agent that plays a game built with the kit through its tool door and reports what it saw.
author: Adrian Ferguson

crons.name: nightly-play
crons.message: List the levels with new_game. Play the first three to a won status. For each level report the level id, the seed, the actions sent, the final status and the state hash. Save a replay only for a result that does not match the rules.
